# Fresh Food Expo Asia Pacific (FFE APAC)

> Fresh Food Expo Asia Pacific is a B2B trade fair connecting the fresh food value chain across Asia Pacific: fresh food, agri-food technology, cold chain logistics and distribution. 16–18 November 2027, Sands Expo & Convention Centre, 10 Bayfront Avenue, Singapore. Organised by Messe Berlin Asia Pacific, the Singapore-based subsidiary of Messe Berlin. Part of Singapore International Agri-Food Week (SIAW) from 2027.

Key facts:
- Event: Fresh Food Expo Asia Pacific 2027 (FFE APAC 2027), a trade fair for industry buyers, suppliers and decision-makers.
- Dates: 16–18 November 2027.
- Venue: Sands Expo & Convention Centre, 10 Bayfront Avenue, Singapore 018956.
- Organiser: Messe Berlin Asia Pacific (https://www.messe-berlin.asia/).
- Three core sectors: Fresh Food; Agri & Fresh Technology; Logistics & Distribution.

## About the event
- [About FFE APAC](https://www.freshfoodexpoapac.com/about/): a B2B trade fair connecting the fresh food value chain from source to market.
- [Our Story](https://www.freshfoodexpoapac.com/our-story/): why Fresh Food Expo APAC exists, a dedicated regional platform where fresh food, technology, logistics, distribution and markets come together.
- [Ecosystem](https://www.freshfoodexpoapac.com/ecosystem/): fresh food meets agri-food technology, cold chain logistics and distribution.
- [Part of SIAW 2027](https://www.freshfoodexpoapac.com/siaw/): FFE APAC is part of Singapore International Agri-Food Week 2027.
- [Organiser: Messe Berlin Asia Pacific](https://www.freshfoodexpoapac.com/messe-berlin/): the Singapore-based subsidiary of Messe Berlin, one of the world's leading trade fair companies since 1822.

## Exhibit
- [Why Exhibit](https://www.freshfoodexpoapac.com/why-exhibit/): put your business in front of the buyers and decision-makers shaping Asia Pacific's fresh food ecosystem.
- [Who Should Exhibit](https://www.freshfoodexpoapac.com/who-should-exhibit/): businesses that bring fresh food from source to buyer.
- [Apply to Exhibit](https://www.freshfoodexpoapac.com/apply-to-exhibit/): send an enquiry to secure a stand; the team replies within three business days.

## Visit
- [Why Visit](https://www.freshfoodexpoapac.com/why-visit/): meet fresh food suppliers and solution providers at one B2B trade fair.
- [Who Should Visit](https://www.freshfoodexpoapac.com/who-should-visit/): buyers, sourcing professionals and decision-makers.
- [Register to Visit](https://www.freshfoodexpoapac.com/register-to-visit/): register your interest as a trade visitor.
- [Plan Your Visit](https://www.freshfoodexpoapac.com/plan-your-visit/): getting to Sands Expo & Convention Centre, visa information, tips and where to stay in Singapore.
